task_description: Upgrade the scaffolded Next.js/TypeScript/Tailwind 'TrustShield' demo app into the full six-screen interactive prototype described in the product spec: Johnson Family (Denver, CO) household with 12 devices, a month of threat history, Trust Score 87, and the privacy 'foggy glass' model. All data is mock/simulated; no real backend. Built for the Vanguard IV high-school innovation challenge team as a reference prototype.
